subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with suitable prepositions, articles and zero articles (a, an, the or x): 0.
stimulus: It was 4 in the afternoon. Hamid was studying (a) _____ the library when his cell phone rang. It was his younger sister, Runa. She said that she was standing (b) _____ front of (c) _____ shopping mall opposite Hamid’s office and asked him to meet her there as soon as possible. Hamid hurried out of (d) _____ library. As he went (e) _____ the street, he noticed that Runa was not alone. She was holding (f) _____ three to four years old girl (g) _____ hand. (h) _____ child was crying and Runa was trying frantically (i) _____ to pacify her. Some passers-by were looking (j) _____them suspiciously. When he reached her, she started to explain.
guide_solution: (a) at/in (b) in (c) a/the (d) the (e) down/along/by (f) a (g) by/in (h) the (i) × (j) at
